visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long black hair tied back in a bun and wearing a black t-shirt speaks to the camera while a young boy in a bright orange Mickey Mouse sweatshirt stands sadly in a room corner. The background is a plain white wall with bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The father holds up a small, white plastic clam-shaped object, presenting it to the boy. The boy looks at the object with a skeptical, pouty expression, standing close to the white wall. (3) The father pulls the boy into a close embrace, hugging him while continuing to hold the toy near the boy's face. The shot is a medium close-up, capturing the boy resting his head on his father's shoulder. (4) The father squeezes the clam toy, and a visible stream of water jets out, hitting the boy's face and nose. The boy blinks in surprise, his facial expression shifting from sadness to amusement. (5) The boy takes the toy and begins to play with it, accidentally snapping the two halves of the shell apart. The father smiles broadly, watching the boy's curious micro-actions as he handles the plastic object. (6) In a close-up shot, the boy wipes his eyes and looks much happier, no longer pouting. He leans in and gives his father a kiss on the cheek, while variety text overlays appear on the screen.

BGM continues at a steady moderate tempo. (3) Sound of a sudden liquid spray followed by the father's high-arousal laughter and a light 'whoosh' sound effect. (5) Sound of a soft smack indicating a kiss. The dialogue becomes faster and more rhythmic between the father and son. BGM fades out at the conclusion.
